== Notes ==
* Psychic Distraction has the fastest [[recharge time]] of all [[List_of_interrupt_skills|interrupt skills]] in the game. 
* This skill bypasses anti-interruption skills such as [[Mantra of Resolve]], as the skill will still be [[disable]]d and so will [[Fail|not complete]] casting.
{{bug|Contrary to the concise description, the interrupt does not need to succeed for the skill to become disabled.}}
